scope.flow: WERC7575Vault withdraw/redeem of assets from a vault whose share owner has been approved by the validator
scope.environment: WERC7575Vault.sol with WRC7575ShareToken permit-based self-approval by the validator

entities.name: validator address granting self-approval via permit

statements.text: The validator has granted self-approval to some address via WRC7575ShareToken::permit(), so an approved address exists in the vault.
The caller of withdraw() or redeem() is an arbitrary address, not restricted to the approved share owner.
The caller invokes withdraw() or redeem() on the vault.
withdraw() and redeem() perform no validation on msg.sender or the receiver, so the caller is not bound to the approved share owner.
Once an address is approved by the validator, only that approved address (or its authorized receiver) should be able to call withdraw() or redeem() and receive the vault assets.
An arbitrary caller should not be able to execute withdraw() or redeem() and take the vault assets out to their own address.

ambiguities: Report does not specify whether the approved address is the validator itself or a separate user; 'self approval' wording is ambiguous.
Report does not state the exact vault balance or asset amount at risk.
Report does not specify whether the attacker must first observe the approval or can act in the same transaction.
Report does not clarify whether the receiver parameter is attacker-controlled in the described call.
